_note: Paper: AlignPose (arXiv 2512.20538). The executable gym is a synthetic, scaled-down substitute for the paper's BOP evaluation: three hidden scene regimes generated at test time by eval/test/ that mirror T-LESS (textureless, cluttered), YCB-V (textured household) and ITODD-MV (grayscale, reflective industrial), each with 60 four-view scenes (256 x 256 px), 3 target objects per scene drawn from an 8-object library not seen in the visible train split, and simulated single-view candidates (depth/rotation errors, gross orientation errors, missed detections, false positives). Metrics follow the paper's BOP protocol per image: AR = mean of AR_MSSD and AR_MSPD (BOP thresholds; VSD is not computed), AP = mean of AP_MSSD and AP_MSPD (BOP/COCO 101-point AP). The paper's numbers are real-data BOP numbers and are NOT on the gym's scale: they are kept for context only, under keys starting with '_paper'. The gym values of the reference and baselines are in scoring/scores_test.json (hidden test) and scoring/scores_train.json (visible train). The non-underscore 'alignpose' entry holds the reproduced reference's own hidden-test values on this gym (from scoring/scores_test.json), not paper numbers.

textureless_clutter.description: T-LESS analog (paper Tables 1 and 4, Co-op candidates): textureless objects in clutter with distractors and occlusion; four calibrated RGB views; single-view candidates with depth/orientation errors, misses and false positives.

AR.description: BOP-style average recall: mean over 10 thresholds of recall under MSSD (5-50% of diameter) and MSPD (5-50 px at 640 px width), averaged over the two errors; evaluated per image as in BOP; one estimate per object and scene.

AP.description: BOP/COCO-style 101-point average precision over the same MSSD and MSPD thresholds, ranked by the submitted confidence, per object then averaged; duplicates and wrong objects are false positives.

textured_household.description: YCB-V analog (paper Tables 1 and 4, Co-op candidates): richly textured household-like objects, lighter clutter; same multi-view protocol.

AR.description: BOP-style average recall over MSSD and MSPD thresholds (see textureless_clutter).

AP.description: BOP/COCO-style average precision over MSSD and MSPD thresholds (see textureless_clutter).

reflective_industrial.description: ITODD-MV analog (paper Tables 1 and 8, FoundPose candidates): grayscale images of specular, weakly textured industrial parts with clutter; same multi-view protocol.

AR.description: BOP-style average recall over MSSD and MSPD thresholds (see textureless_clutter).

AP.description: BOP/COCO-style average precision over MSSD and MSPD thresholds (see textureless_clutter).

housecat6d_foundpose.note: Transparent/metallic household objects; not reproduced (the synthetic renderer has no transparency).
